# The OpenDoc edit vocabulary, version 1.0

12 commands in 5 families. 7 can be tracked suggestions, 2 are refused in suggest mode with the published reason, and 3 are not content edits (comments and review decisions). They are the agent-side twins of 31 editor command ids; 137 editor ids that can change a document are not exposed to agents, each with a reason (`commands.json` `uiNotExposed`).

| `op` | Family | Summary | Trackable | Editor twins |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `insert_text` | text | Insert text at an anchor. | yes | `edit.pasteText`, `insert.symbol`, `insert.emoji` |
| `replace_text` | text | Replace the quoted text with new text. | yes | `edit.replace` |
| `delete_text` | text | Delete the quoted text. | yes | `edit.cut` |
| `insert_paragraphs` | paragraph | Insert new paragraphs after an anchor's paragraph. | yes | none (agent-only) |
| `apply_paragraph_style` | styles | Apply a paragraph style, by name or id. | yes | `paragraph.heading.1`, `paragraph.heading.2`, `paragraph.heading.3`, `paragraph.normal`, `style.` |
| `set_text_format` | text | Set bold, italic, underline, strike, size, colour, highlight or font on the quoted text. | yes | `format.bold`, `format.italic`, `format.underline`, `format.strike`, `format.color`, `format.highlight`, `format.family`, `format.family.`, `format.size`, `format.size.` |
| `set_cell_text` | tables | Set the text of one table cell. | yes | none (agent-only) |
| `table_insert_row` | tables | Insert an empty row at an index; a vertical merge it lands inside grows to cover it. | no: Table rows cannot be suggested yet: tracked table structure is not modelled (docs/178 Q11). Use mode `direct` under a profile that grants `edit`. | `table.insert.rowAbove`, `table.insert.rowBelow` |
| `table_delete_row` | tables | Delete one row; a merged cell anchored in it keeps its content on the next row. | no: Table rows cannot be suggested yet: tracked table structure is not modelled (docs/178 Q11). Use mode `direct` under a profile that grants `edit`. | `table.delete.row` |
| `comment` | review | Comment on the quoted text, or reply to a comment. | not-applicable | `review.comment` |
| `resolve_comment` | review | Resolve or reopen a comment thread. | not-applicable | `review.comment.resolve` |
| `review` | review | Accept or reject named tracked changes, or all of them. | not-applicable | `review.acceptAtCaret`, `review.rejectAtCaret`, `review.acceptNext`, `review.rejectNext`, `review.acceptAll`, `review.rejectAll` |
